records.purpose: Atomically adds/replaces an owned complete preorder tree. ID/title <=63 bytes; 1..256 nodes, aligned stride >=80 and node size within stride. Unique nonzero node IDs, parent 0 or preceding active ROW/COLUMN; all subtrees contiguous. Copies valid UTF-8 labels/text/items <=255 bytes; 256 items/node and 16 table columns. Zero unused fields; finite/ranged numeric values and valid selections. Failure preserves old tree/callback.

records.ownership: Host deep-copies tree/strings on success; fn/ctx borrowed until successful replacement/removal or ordinary owner release. No allocation transfer.

records.reentrancy: Callbacks may invoke commands or replace/remove own panel; generation change drops remaining stale events, new tree renders next pass. Registry lock not held during plugin code.
records.results: OK; WRONG_THREAD off game thread; UNAVAILABLE stopped service/host; BAD_ARG malformed owner/ID/title/tree/size/stride/data; TOO_MANY limits or allocation failure. Failure atomic.

records.cleanup: Successful replacement/removal and ordinary owner release discard stale-generation events and end borrowed callbacks. Fault guard stops delivery; retained-provider faults skip ordinary resource release until restart. No separate cancel token.

records.signature: sco_result (*)(sco_plugin *, const char *, const sco_widget_node *, uint32_t, uint32_t)
records.purpose: Atomically replaces or inserts one subtree of an owned panel. nodes[0] is the root and every later node descends from it; node, stride and string rules as set_panel, with 1.0 or 1.1 node sizes. An existing root ID is replaced in place and keeps its parent; a new root ID becomes the last child of parent 0 or an existing ROW/COLUMN. IDs must not collide with nodes outside the replaced subtree; 256 nodes/panel and 4096 live nodes after the change. Failure preserves the tree.
